Other middle slots and the bottom layer finish unchanged. Upper turns move only the upper layer. An upper edge is aligned for insertion when its SIDE sticker matches its adjacent SIDE center; the UP sticker is not compared to the up center for this purpose. A middle edge belongs where BOTH stickers match their adjacent centers.
